summary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited third-quarter 2026 earnings release. Total operating revenues fell roughly 10% to US$1.17 billion from US$1.31 billion; operating income was US$100.2 million versus US$184.5 million; Adjusted Property EBITDA was US$287.6 million versus US$380.4 million; net income attributable to the company was US$34 thousand, or US$0.00009 per ADS, versus US$74.7 million prior year. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory element is present. This is a routine earnings disclosure with no special-situations event to arbitrage.
